title: International Audio/Video Remote Kunama Interpreter (Must also speak Tigrinya or Arabic)
description: Overview: As an audio/video interpreter for Kunama and Tigrinya or Arabic in LSA’s network of Independently Contracted Interpreters, you are responsible for handling audio and video calls on demand and facilitating language communication for the Limited English Proficient (LEP) community in a variety of settings. Language Services Associates is continuously accepting qualified interpreters! Responsibilities: · Provide effective audio and video interpreting through a web based platform · Answer inbound calls in a timely manner · Provide superior customer service · Adhere to Code of Professional Conduct, including maintaining strict standards of confidentiality · Adhere to all policies and procedures, including professional interpretation protocols and industry specific best practices Qualifications/Experience: · Full fluency in both English and Kunama and Tigrinya or Arabic · Technology proficient (web-based platforms, email, Microsoft Word) · An interpreting space that is quiet, secure, and free from outside noises · 1+ years of professional interpreting experience preferred · Industry specific certifications/trainings preferred (CMI, CCHI, etc.) LSA is passionate about what we do, which is helping people thrive in an increasingly global environment and in recognition of our commitment to excellence, LSA was named a Top Provider and a Top Workplace in 2026. If interested, please apply and include a copy of your resume, which emphasizes your interpreting experience.

title: Localisation Specialist (Translator) - Arabic & French
description: About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About The Role The Communications team makes sure every message counts. They turn complex ideas into clear, compelling stories that resonate across the business and beyond. By shaping how Revolut speaks to the world, they connect teams, amplify our brand, and ensure the right message reaches the right audience at the right time. We’re looking for a Localisation Specialist (Translator) to help us bring Revolut to Arabic and French-speaking customers. You’ll play a key role in ensuring our content isn't just translated, but truly localised and culturally relevant to the market. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What You'll Be Doing Copying HTML content Delivering high-quality copy adapted in your target language (transcription) for all types of content produced (app, website, emails, etc.) Ensuring daily volume expectations are met Adapting long-term strategic brand, tone, and vision to local markets, cultural differences, and perceptions Suggesting long-term strategic content projects Contributing to live translation updates, maintaining the brand's tone of voice and strategic messaging that aligns to wider company goals What You'll Need Fluency in Arabic (native level) Fluency in English Fluency in French (native level) A bachelor's degree 1+ years of experience in localisation/translations, translating content in a similar field Excellent writing, editorial, and reviewing skills Experience writing creative and engaging content A joy for working in the intersection of copy and transcreation Expertise adapting to a specified tone of voice and with brand-led strategic messaging A data-driven approach and awareness of the importance of appropriately quantifying your work Team player abilities with experience collaborating across functions Great self-organisation skills to keep cool when working to tight deadlines Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it
